desc: Ideation: best-first search over monotone 3D grid (sorted A, B, C descending), O(K log K), avoids flawed pair-enumeration and infeasible binary-search counting.
Discard binary-search/counting approach (counting triples ≥ V is O(N²) per check; not viable).
Implement heap solution with visited-set dedup; verified Sample 1 by hand (5th pop = 31), Sample 2 (all equal → 30000), and edge cases N=1, K=1, K=N³.
Final Python code with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), Python-native big-int arithmetic, delivered.
